notes.title: The Boring Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992824/b0446aa24b24b959350c4aca33b250d28a9160da.png[/img]

[h2]Controller support[/h2]
This update adds controller support to the game, including navigating menus and building your ship.

This update also includes a fix for keybinds, where after you set your keybinds I was forgetting to save what you set them as.

Please let me know if any of the controller specific changes don't work, or if any of them could be better. Finally, thank you for playing my game!

notes.title: Small patch for demo
notes.notes:
Keys can now be used on the Threat screen to open a shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992824/ec019427080e8ed365fee6286e5b3da360db21c9.png[/img]

You can use the shop to trade two of your systems for a system you don't currently have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992824/9e3a9ba4b1f56054d45dc299c4297139618dfc27.png[/img]

Added 4 more systems.

Thanks for playing the demo!

notes.title: Small patch for demo
notes.notes:
Added 2 more systems.

Tooltips now display what stats are being changed, and how those systems are changing those stats:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992824/3c22de20effa75a54283f408a6caa87c5d65ecc4.png[/img]

Enemies in close proximity now swarm together instead of clumping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992824/2fe6e7b2e061d3c06d18c86febb4745a3a465ba9.gif[/img]

Fixed a rare bug where some systems could be "re-dropped", instead of dropping a system you don't yet have.

Thanks for playing the demo!

notes.title: Small patch for demo
notes.notes:
Increased effect of components on Weapons and Auto Shot dramatically for the first few components attached to these systems.

Engines max speed per component: 50 -> 75
Engines thrust per component: 8 -> 12

Thanks for playing the demo everyone, if you have further feedback please let me know. Enjoy!
